retrieval_skill.name: separate_sensor_failure_from_dynamics
retrieval_skill.description: Distinguish unreliable high-frequency observations from the validity of lower-frequency latent-process models, then retrieve evidence about the underlying motion mechanism and forecast endpoint rather than extrapolating the last observed level.
retrieval_skill.applicability: When telemetry reliability varies by frequency or measurement layer and the forecast depends on whether an apparent local level reflects persistence or an evolving latent process.
retrieval_skill.query_strategy: Search separately for evidence on observation reliability, unaffected model components, the inferred dynamic mechanism, and the projected terminal state within the forecast window; prefer sources that explicitly connect model validity to the forecast implication.
retrieval_skill.verification_rule: Accept the mechanism-based forecast only when evidence independently establishes the measurement failure's scope, confirms that the forecasting model is unaffected, and supports both the direction of change and the terminal state; preserve provenance, temporal-window constraints, and exact wording where quotes are required.
